\section{Profile}
\begin{onecolentry}
DevOps Engineer with 5 years of experience (including 3 years in a work-study programme) designing \textbf{CI/CD pipelines}, automating \textbf{cloud infrastructure (AWS)}, and deploying applications. Advanced skills in \textbf{Docker}, \textbf{Kubernetes}, \textbf{Linux administration}, and \textbf{Infrastructure as Code (Terraform, Ansible)}. Product-focused, with an understanding of \textbf{FinOps} and cloud cost optimisation. Experienced in working with international stakeholders in \textbf{Agile/Scrum} teams. Fluent professional English (\textbf{TOEIC 940/990}).
\end{onecolentry}
